name: zolitron
description: This is the project of group zolitron-2

scripts.install:all:win: npm run install:client && npm run create:venv:win && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:all:mac: npm run install:client && npm run create:venv:mac && npm run install:backend:linux
scripts.install:all:linux: npm run install:client && npm run create:venv:linux && npm run install:backend:linux
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,backend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run client" "npm run backend"
scripts.dev:linux: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,backend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run client" "npm run backend:linux"
